name: Dual Nationality Certificate (Bangladeshi-Origin Diaspora)

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of Bangladeshi origin: a previous Bangladeshi passport or NID, or (for foreign-born applicants) a foreign birth certificate plus parents' Bangladeshi documentation.
Has acquired citizenship in a foreign country via naturalisation, evidenced by a foreign naturalisation/citizenship certificate.

evidence_required.document: Prior Bangladeshi passport/NID, or foreign birth certificate + parents' BD documents

sources.title: Online Security Clearance System, Ministry of Home Affairs, Bangladesh -- Dual Citizenship Certificate service: formal government application channel for Bangladeshi-origin persons who have acquired foreign citizenship, with a downloadable guideline document, online application, and status tracking

LegalSeba (Bangladeshi legal services firm) -- Dual Citizenship Guide: eligible for holders of citizenship from ~101 countries (broadly North America, all of Europe including the UK, Brazil, Argentina, Japan, South Korea, among others); explicitly excludes India and Pakistan (no reciprocal treaty); fee ~BDT 5,000, processing 3-6 months including police verification

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bangladesh). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- the core mechanism (a formal Ministry of Home Affairs application channel, tier-1, directly confirmed via the government's own SSD portal) supports the two modeled hard requirements (Bangladeshi origin + acquired foreign citizenship). DISCLOSED BUT NOT MODELED AS A HARD REQUIREMENT: the specific list of ~101 eligible foreign-citizenship countries (and the explicit exclusion of India and Pakistan for lack of reciprocity) comes only from a tier-3 legal-services firm, not independently tier-1 confirmed -- omitted from requirement_groups to keep this file's hard requirements cleanly tier-1, but this is a materially important restriction an applicant needs to know, hence flagged here rather than silently dropped. dual_citizenship_allowed is TRUE for this specific route (unlike Bangladesh's general citizenship rule, which otherwise requires foreign-citizenship renunciation per the Citizenship Act 1951 -- see bd_citizenship_naturalisation.json) -- this Dual Nationality Certificate mechanism is precisely the exception that lets Bangladeshi-origin diaspora keep both nationalities simultaneously. Distinct from bd_citizenship_by_investment.json, which is for people with NO prior Bangladeshi origin acquiring citizenship for the first time via investment.
